analysis.investment_thesis: Methodhub shows the kind of explosive topline (35→57→135 Cr, nearly 4x in two years) and ROE of 42.7% that I'd normally find exciting in a 144 Cr micro-cap. But promoter holding at just 26.85% — well below my 50% skin-in-the-game threshold — and OCF of only 5 Cr against PAT of 11 Cr kills the conviction.
key_strengths: Perfect small-cap size (144 Cr) in IT services — huge TAM with secular tailwind
Revenue 3.8x in 2 years (35→135 Cr) with ROE 42.7% and ROCE 31.1%
P/E 14x is reasonable if the growth is real and durable
key_risks: Promoter holding only 26.85% — fails my core SMILE skin-in-the-game test
OCF of 5 Cr vs PAT of 11 Cr — earnings not converting to cash (receivables bloat?)
Borrowings up to 39 Cr (D/E ~0.68); finance cost 5 Cr is eating ~30% of operating income
red_flags: Equity jumped 11→57 Cr in FY25 — likely dilutive fundraise, explains low promoter stake
FCF trend declining (7→4→4 Cr) despite revenue nearly quadrupling
IT services staff-aug players often show fake-looking growth that reverses in downcycles
analysis.detailed_analysis:
On paper, the numbers jump off the page — a 144 Cr IT services company growing revenue from 35 Cr to 135 Cr in two years with 42.7% ROE and P/E of only 14x is exactly the kind of undiscovered micro-cap I hunt for. Incorporated in 2016, it fits the "medium in experience" bucket, and IT services is certainly a large-market-potential space. The SMILE framework ticks several boxes on size, experience, and market TAM.

But two things stop me cold. First, promoter holding at 26.85% is a hard fail — Kedia's rule is 50%+ skin-in-the-game, and the FY25 equity jump from 11 to 57 Cr suggests recent heavy dilution, meaning the promoter isn't buying the story as hard as outsiders are. Second, operating cash flow at 5 Cr against reported PAT of 11 Cr in FY25, combined with rising borrowings, tells me this growth is being funded by debt and working capital stretch — a classic small-cap IT services red flag. I'd want to see two more years of OCF tracking PAT and promoter reinforcing ownership before committing. HOLD / watchlist only.
